properties.description: **Essential** — Baseline hygiene for Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): the non-negotiable controls every deployment should enforce from day one. This tier delivers TLS / HTTPS enforcement preventing in-transit interception. Together these policies protect against credential theft, unencrypted data exposure, and accidental data loss. Maps to CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001 Annex A.10 (cryptography) and A.12 (operations).

metadata.policyName: Azure Active Directory Domain Services managed domains should use TLS 1.2 only mode
